name: Abnormal Lovers
source:
Hinata lives with his mother Mayoi and his older sister Akeno, while training as a cook at the family’s Café Carroll. Even though his childhood friend Mimi causes a ruckus every day, he leads a peaceful and happy life while aiming to become a full-fledged cook.

However, his mother got in an accident one day and he had to take over running the family business until she recovered. The popular grade A student Seri, childhood friend Mimi and quiet classmate Yukana all came to live and work at the coffee shop for varying reasons. He was wondering if everything will turn out alright when the three girls, along with his older sister Akeno, made advances on him starting from that very first night. Moreover, it was an abnormal type of love!

[From [url=https://omochikaeri.wordpress.com/2017/11/08/november-2017-eroge-releases/]Hau~ Omochikaeri~![/url]]
translation:
阳向与母亲真宵和姐姐明乃住在一起，同时在家庭经营的卡罗尔咖啡馆学习厨艺。尽管青梅竹马美美每天都闹出骚动，他仍然一边追求成为独当一面的厨师，一边过着平静幸福的生活。

然而，一天母亲遭遇事故，阳向必须在她康复前接手经营家业。成绩优秀的人气学生芹、青梅竹马美美和沉默的同班同学由香娜，因各自理由来到咖啡馆生活工作。阳向正担心一切能否顺利，三个女孩和姐姐明乃却从第一晚开始向他主动示好。而且，这是一种异常的爱！
